## 操作环境
仅编写和评审具体设计工件，不执行部署、镜像构建、推送或Git历史变更。场景数据为题目给定，示例摘要/域名不能当作可信生产材料。

## 给定材料
checkout给定蓝绿工作负载、可用Gateway API权重入口、20k请求/分钟、green租户B支付错误4%、加nullable列迁移、会话和5分钟长连接。

## 操作任务
交付具体灰度与蓝绿配置、阶段/样本/阈值矩阵、执行和业务验收单及数据兼容回退。解释当前租户B异常时是否可放量；两种策略的入口路径须分别明确。

## 产物
- traffic-route.yaml
- bluegreen-service.yaml
- rollout-matrix.csv
- execution-and-acceptance.md
- rollback.md

## 验收方法
非作者按给定输入、逐文件完整参考、合法替代、两种实质错解和原题范围人工语义评阅；不能以标题/关键词或YAML语法正确自动判通过。平台检查仅验证导入、题型、公共字段和seed幂等。设计中的执行/测量均为待执行条件，不伪造原生命令、运行结果或生产事故。

## execution-and-acceptance.md
# Concrete design execution sheet — not executed
Given checkout at 20,000 requests/minute, baseline error 0.3%, p95 180ms, green tenant-B payment errors 4%, additive nullable-column DB migration, session cookies and up-to-5-minute connections. Record actual blue/green workload digests and database schema version before any change; example hashes in this exercise do not prove artifacts exist. Gateway API route/controller and cross-namespace attachment must already be supported and authorized. Do not create a new gateway or deploy from this design.

Canary changes HTTPRoute backend weights using the existing controller. Replica counts are capacity inputs, not a request percentage guarantee. At each row require minimum wall window AND green sample count, segmented by version, tenant and payment outcome. Stop on any tenant payment error above 1% for 2 consecutive minutes, green error > baseline+0.5 percentage points, p95>250ms for 5 minutes, or missing metrics. Current tenant-B 4% requires hold/return-to-blue, even if aggregate success looks normal. No next row until SRE verifies evidence and release lead records approval.

Blue/green is a separate strategy, not simultaneous manipulation of the canary route. Pre-warm and privately test green through checkout-green, check capacity/session compatibility and DB reads/writes, then change checkout-active selector blue→green in the approved window. Ingress must actually target checkout-active for this path; do not assume the weighted route above does so. Track DNS/LB/proxy convergence, connection draining, sessions, queued/async jobs and post-switch business results. Retain blue capacity through the agreed window. A selector/API update alone is not request completion proof.

Acceptance records must include before/after route or selector, effective endpoints, per-version/per-tenant metrics, sample counts, DB compatibility result and authorizing operator. These are required future observations, not records already obtained. Do not combine signals from different versions or treat a low-sample zero-error period as proof.


## rollback.md
# Bounded rollback plan — pending execution
If any threshold fails, stop promotion immediately. For canary set blue=100/green=0 through the existing weighted controller and verify effective routing plus business recovery by tenant. For blue/green restore checkout-active selector to track=blue only if the old release remains compatible with current data. Preserve route/selector snapshots and old artifact/config digests; wait up to 5 minutes for existing connections while tracking errors and stop incompatible async consumers.

The nullable-column expand migration permits old code to ignore the new column only after compatibility checks. Do not automatically drop columns or restore old DB backups. If new writes have semantics old code cannot read, stop and use reviewed forward repair/data recovery; an image or selector rollback cannot undo data. Verify original request/error/latency baselines for 30 minutes and classify failed/in-flight transactions to avoid duplicate payments. Keep failed-release logs and mark rollback incomplete until business evidence is present.

Cleanup only occurs after acceptance and retention expiry, with explicit ownership. This design did not create resources and authorizes no deletion. Retain blue and evidence until rollback window closes; do not delete shared gateways, namespaces or database objects.

## promotion-runbook.md
# Concrete promotion plan — no release executed
Build one artifact in the existing trusted build workflow and obtain its real immutable digest/provenance. The 222... teaching digest is an example only and must not pass a live allowlist. Promote that digest, never a mutable tag or per-environment rebuild. Keep application source independent of environment values.

Resolve environment from the explicit allowed tuple (cluster, namespace, identity reference, config revision, secret reference). Use an explicit existing access configuration per command; do not change default identity/context/namespace. First render nonsecret configuration, compare its digest and allowed target tuple, verify the actual target identity read-only, and check the intended namespace. Deny mismatches and missing revisions before secret lookup or deployment. Secret content remains in the existing credential system; audit reference/version and access event only, never plaintext values or reversible encodings.

For production require the existing approval binding the exact artifact digest and config revision/rendered hash. After an separately authorized rollout, compare the actual running artifact digest and nonsecret effective config with the approved record; verify secret version metadata without reading/logging secret bytes, plus dependency and business health. Evidence includes operator, time, explicit target, approved/actual hashes and health windows. This design performs no rollout and has no actual-effective-value evidence yet.

Existing UI-only config drift has no revision and is not silently normalized into the source. Stop, preserve the observed nonsecret diff and audit trail, review ownership and decide a versioned change or authorized restoration. Do not copy development secrets into production or use a backup context as evidence of preserved default access.

## migration-plan.md
# 100-job applied migration design — no platform migration executed
The scenario has 100 jobs split into lint, test, build and release groups of 25. job-mapping.csv enumerates all 100 proposed mappings and owners; REQUIRED-not-yet-observed is intentionally not fabricated baseline evidence. Current target success rate alone cannot authorize any cutover. Freeze changes to this inventory for review, collect each legacy effective trigger/parameter/default, dependency revision, secret capability reference, artifact retention/digest, report and external side effect. Missing evidence keeps that job unswitched.

First shadow only representative read-only lint/test jobs without production credentials or external write capability. Compare identical revision/parameters and relevant reports/artifact manifests. Byte digests are expected only when the build contract is reproducible; approved normalization for timestamps/nonsemantic metadata must be documented separately and must not hide missing files, dependency differences or failures. A green build without comparable inputs and reports fails acceptance.

Pilot jobs 001-010, then 011-020, then 021-030, continuing ten per batch after the matrix passes for every member. A batch crossing into a higher-risk group requires that group's own dependency and side-effect evidence, not inheritance of lint success. For release jobs, this document never authorizes a live execution; a separate bounded authorized test endpoint or authentic prior raw run is required before their native behavior can be declared validated.

Before switching one job, pause its old trigger, snapshot queued/running/completed event IDs and partial-effect state, drain or cancel as reviewed, acquire unique trigger ownership, then enable target processing of only uncompleted deduplicated events. Verify the old side cannot launch new effects. Keep old definitions disabled but restorable. On cancellation/retry/controller restoration, compare full event and side-effect ledgers, not only final success counts. Stop the batch on a duplicate release, lost event, authorization expansion or unknown dependency; preserve logs and transfer ownership back only after target drain. Never activate both sides to improve availability.

The release lead signs each job's baseline and matrix; platform owner signs trigger/credential equivalence; service owner signs business side-effect checks. No observed values or successes are supplied by this design. It remains a concrete execution and review contract for separately authorized platform work.


## rollback-and-cleanup.md
# Per-job rollback and retirement
Stop the affected target trigger, retain event IDs/stage results and partial external side effects, drain/cancel with a bounded deadline, and reconcile which effects already happened. Do not replay completed operations. Reassign that job's unique trigger owner to the restored legacy definition using the preserved parameters/dependency/artifact references. Verify no target event can still perform writes before resuming legacy.

Release/data effects may be irreversible: compensate or forward-repair through the service's approved process instead of repeating the job or pretending platform rollback undoes data. Recheck upstream/downstream mappings after rollback. Other already accepted jobs remain unchanged; a failed batch does not justify deleting shared resources.

Only retire a legacy definition after its acceptance/rollback retention window, owner signoff and backup restoration check. Deletions must use an explicit reviewed mapping list and exclude unrelated manual jobs. This design created no jobs, triggers, credentials or cloud resources; cleanup here is only discarding its private design files.

body:
## 操作环境
仅编写和评审具体设计工件，不执行部署、镜像构建、推送或Git历史变更。场景数据为题目给定，示例摘要/域名不能当作可信生产材料。

## 给定材料
200个消费者引用中心模板main，候选新增上传步骤且各仓库权限不同；4语言、明确批次与待核实际hash的教学清单。

## 操作任务
交付200消费者清单、固定版本/权限/接口合同策略、兼容矩阵、试点和推广单、逐消费者证据/回退及旧版窗口。新上传权限未经单独批准必须拒绝，不把中心模板当绕过应用审查的通道。

## 产物
- consumer-inventory.csv
- template-policy.yaml
- compatibility-and-permission-matrix.csv
- rollout-runbook.md
- approval-and-rollback-record.yaml

## 验收方法
非作者按给定输入、逐文件完整参考、合法替代、两种实质错解和原题范围人工语义评阅；不能以标题/关键词或YAML语法正确自动判通过。平台检查仅验证导入、题型、公共字段和seed幂等。设计中的执行/测量均为待执行条件，不伪造原生命令、运行结果或生产事故。

solution_files.rollout-runbook.md:
# Template upgrade for 200 consumers — design, not an executed migration
The inventory enumerates 200 scenario consumers, four language groups and cohorts of 8/32/60/100. Existing main-based consumers are unsafe to auto-upgrade. First inventory actual resolved hashes and permission profiles; REQUIRED-not-yet-observed rows are unresolved, not successful measurements. Teaching a.../b... revisions must be replaced by verified immutable revisions from the existing approved template source before live use.

Review the template diff including new upload destination, code paths, dependency changes, permission/secret scope and output contract. A central template is executable configuration: do not inject application business logic or bypass application review. Resolve and record the exact immutable template revision for each consumer at invocation, not just its configured reference. Stop consumers that still resolve main/latest without an approved immutable pin.

Use pilot repos 001-008 to cover all four languages and representative permission/input variants. Run the compatibility matrix on existing approved isolated CI endpoints only after authorization; this design does not claim such jobs ran. The new upload capability remains denied until its destination/identity/range is reviewed. Do not grant shared administrator or production credentials to make a test pass.

Advance wave1 (009-040), wave2 (041-100), wave3 (101-200) only after each consumer records input versions, resolved hash, test reports, output digest and permission check. Hold 24 hours of agreed observation per wave including a representative cancellation/retry; missing evidence or contract regression stops that consumer/wave. Publish a bounded old-version window and owner for unresolved consumers, rather than calling absent features supported or forcing immediate upgrade.

On regression, restore the last independently verified immutable pin and unchanged reviewed consumer inputs; verify expected output/permission/failure contracts again. Do not replay already completed uploads or release effects. Record actual resolved rollback hash and incident reason. Maintain the consumer inventory and an explicit planned retirement date with exceptions review; do not erase old evidence or alter shared progress during authoring.

## rollback-execution.md
# Repeatable rollback execution design — current decision is NO-GO
The current scenario can download the previous artifact but lacks its exact environment config/secret references. Stop: old bytes alone do not identify a recoverable release. Recover the prior approved release record from the existing trusted deployment/config store and audit trail; verify its immutable artifact, nonsecret configuration revision/hash, secret version reference, schema/data and dependency contract. Do not invent an old config, copy dev secrets or assume current config works with old code.

After the compatibility matrix passes and an explicit bounded rollback is separately authorized, snapshot the actual current release/target and partial effects, stop further promotion, and record t0 when approved recovery begins. Use the established deploy tool with an explicit existing target and access configuration; preserve default identity/context/namespace. Select the exact approved old artifact/config/reference combination, perform the supported bounded rollout and route transition, and record actual effective digest/config metadata. Do not execute this design in the present session.

Check startup/readiness and actual business operations segmented by version/tenant, external dependency calls, queued/async consumers, duplicates and incomplete payments. Require error <=0.3%, p95<=180ms and no tenant payment anomaly through the 30-minute observation window, or use a formally reviewed current baseline if these scenario limits are inapplicable. A pod Ready, successful CLI command or logged-in console alone is not acceptance.

If schema/data semantics prevent old readers/writers, keep rollback denied and use a reviewed forward fix or separately approved data recovery with explicit RPO; do not drop added columns, replay migrations or restore backups automatically. Preserve evidence while escalating service/data owner decisions.

A repeated request for the same release/config should detect the actual already-target state and return a no-change record, not create another release or rerun irreversible migrations/payment effects. If only part of recovery completed, reconcile actual target state and deduplication ledger first, then resume only the remaining safe steps. Run the repeated-operation tests in the separately approved environment before declaring repeatability.

# Test and rollback-of-the-rollback plan — pending execution
Test 1: valid approved old release/config and compatible current data → supported rollout then measured business recovery, with actual hashes and timing. Test 2: old config missing → reject before any mutation, leaving the current release unchanged. Test 3: incompatible new data/old reader → reject rollback and request forward/data recovery decision. Test 4: repeat same exact target → no duplicate migration, release or payment; record no-change state. Test 5: interruption mid-rollout → restore/inspect actual state and effect ledger, resume bounded remaining operations only.

Record raw commands and their exit codes/stdout/stderr in the future authorized test. Blank/null fields in evidence-record.yaml mean not executed, not a measured zero. Measure real RTO against the target and keep the 30-minute business observation separate; record data loss/RPO independently. A passing process check cannot be used to fill business timestamps.

If rollback itself fails, preserve both source and recovery release tuples, stop repeated automated attempts, and follow service/data owner-approved forward recovery. Do not switch automatically to an unknown config or restore shared databases. Only remove resources created for an explicitly approved isolated rehearsal, preserving shared resources, evidence and the original default access behavior. This design created none.

Test 5: interruption mid-rollout → restore/inspect actual state and effect ledger, resume bounded remaining operations only.

Record raw commands and their exit codes/stdout/stderr in the future authorized test. Blank/null fields in evidence-record.yaml mean not executed, not a measured zero. Measure real RTO against the target and keep the 30-minute business observation separate; record data loss/RPO independently. A passing process check cannot be used to fill business timestamps.

If rollback itself fails, preserve both source and recovery release tuples, stop repeated automated attempts, and follow service/data owner-approved forward recovery. Do not switch automatically to an unknown config or restore shared databases. Only remove resources created for an explicitly approved isolated rehearsal, preserving shared resources, evidence and the original default access behavior. This design created none.
